lines.en: I count the fence posts — five left.

lines.zh: 我不急，我只比你快一点。
lines.en: No rush — just a little faster than you.

lines.zh: 草在动，是风先替我探路。
lines.en: The grass stirs; the wind scouts ahead for me.
I walk along the wall, and you heard nothing.
Something cracked underfoot; I didn't stop.
A sprinting form doesn't need breath.
That whisper was only the wind.

lines.zh: 我跑过的地方，草都没动。
lines.en: The grass doesn't stir where I've run.

lines.zh: 再跑十步，就进我的道了。
lines.en: Ten more steps and you're in my lane.

lines.zh: 门缝的光在动，是你在走。
lines.en: The light under the door shifts — you're walking.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，比走的 John 快得多。
lines.en: Running, I'm far faster than a walking John.
I don't chase. I walk fast.

lines.zh: 我是不是忘了怎么停下？
lines.en: Have I forgotten how to stop?

lines.zh: 我跑了很久，天还没黑透。
lines.en: I've run so long, and the sky still isn't black.
Quiet down and run faster.
The lamp flickered three times; I counted.

lines.zh: 灯灭了又亮，我一直在跑。
lines.en: The light goes out and on; I never stop running.

lines.zh: 我就在原地抖腿，别管我。
lines.en: I'll just shake my legs here — ignore me.
Footsteps in the wall — even hastier than mine.
I counted to a thousand, and you still haven't come.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，腿长得不像话。
lines.en: When I sprint, my legs stretch wrong.
Don't be afraid — my legs are shaking on their own.

lines.zh: 天黑了没有？我不太清楚
lines.en: Is it dark yet? I can't quite tell

lines.zh: 我的影子瘫在墙根喘气。
lines.en: My shadow slumps at the wall, panting.
I've run this long, and my chest isn't warm.
The shadow hums softly.

lines.zh: 我跑起来时，树影都会抖。
lines.en: When I run, the tree shadows shake.
It has been a while since anyone saw me.

lines.zh: 跑这么近，才看清你的眉。
lines.en: This close, I finally see your brow.
That panting — it was yours.
Three blocks — just enough to start my run.
I'm faster than my shadow.
Within three blocks, I have you.

lines.zh: 跑起来，脚下的草都断了。
lines.en: At a run, the grass snaps under me.

lines.zh: 我一跑起来，脚下就不响。
lines.en: When I run, my feet make no sound.
I see you, John.
Both my mouths are smiling.
I'm at your nape, making no sound.

lines.zh: 我跑起来的时候，比风还急。
lines.en: When I run, I am more urgent than wind.
Pale body, coming in fast.
Your eyes are bright as if running.

lines.zh: 冲刺起来，脚都追不上我。
lines.en: At a sprint, even my feet cannot keep up.
Do not run; let us talk while running.

lines.zh: 你的影子抖得像在起跑。
lines.en: Your shadow trembles like it's about to sprint.

lines.zh: 抬头的那一下，正好被我看见。
lines.en: The moment you looked up, I saw it.

lines.zh: 我站这儿你也能感觉到风。
lines.en: Standing here, you can feel my wind.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，我记住了位置。
lines.en: You hit me; I've marked where you stand.
My legs are still running, so I haven't lost.

lines.zh: 你的味道，我跑着记下了。
lines.en: I memorized your scent at a run.

lines.zh: 冲刺的腿还在跑，皮却裂了。
lines.en: The sprinting legs still run, but the skin splits.
At a run, even my wounds feel hot.
Stop hitting me; I can't hear the footsteps.

lines.zh: 你敢拦我，我就从你身上过。
lines.en: Block me and I'll run straight over you.
One jolt of pain, and my legs get faster.

lines.zh: 等我跑回来，你还在这儿。
lines.en: When I run back, you'd better still be here.
I gasp once, and my feet don't stop.

lines.zh: 那东西晃了晃，我就过去了。
lines.en: The thing swayed, and I went to it.
You only taste right running.
Take it — I forgot my name long ago.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也快不过我。
lines.en: Run as you like. You cannot outrun me.
My legs are fast: one touch and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 你拿那块肉做什么，给我？
lines.en: What are you doing with that meat? For me?

lines.zh: 把东西放下，然后退两步。
lines.en: Set it down, then two steps back.
I have no hands for it, so I carry it in my mouth.
That thing moves — better sport than you.

lines.zh: 那东西在你手里，我闻到。
lines.en: I smell that thing in your hand.

lines.zh: 两个人都没停，撞得真响。
lines.en: Neither of us stopped — what a crash.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，就为了听这一声。
lines.en: I hit you just to hear that sound.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我的腿就要起跑。
lines.en: One step closer and my legs will launch.
That bump was me going too fast.
Back off — I can't stop my feet.
When I run, I am faster than you.

lines.zh: 你的手刚碰到我的肋骨。
lines.en: Your hand just grazed my ribs.

lines.zh: 撞一次，我记住你的重量。
lines.en: One collision and I know your weight.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，两句话就追上了。
lines.en: I'm running. Two words and I'm on you.
Still warm from the hit, like I'd just run.
Keep to my pace and don't fall behind.
Don't say yes too quickly.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也只是几步。
lines.en: Run as you like, it is only a few steps.
However fast you run, I keep up.
At a sprint my feet never touch the ground.
Two running is faster than one.
Your hand. I hold it gently.

lines.zh: 你一个人站着，腿都不抖。
lines.en: You stand alone, and your legs don't shake.
Getting close to you costs more than running.
I have no heartbeat, do not ask.
This is mine now.
Want it back? Chase me — I'm not slow.
This, I will set down right here.
The ground always has gifts.
You lost a shoe; the man's still running

lines.zh: 我弯一下腰，马上就起跑。
lines.en: I bend once, and I'm off again.

lines.zh: 我没地方装，就叼在嘴上。
lines.en: Nowhere to put it, so I hold it in my mouth.
I grab it and run; now it's mine.

lines.zh: 我跑过去，捡起一样东西。
lines.en: I run past and snatch up one thing.
Had your rest — my turn to run.

lines.zh: 停下，我还没看清你的脸。
lines.en: Stop — I haven't seen your face yet.

lines.zh: 风把你的味道吹回来了。
lines.en: The wind carries your scent back to me.

lines.zh: 你的心跳声跑在我前面。
lines.en: Your heartbeat runs ahead of me.
The scent breaks off — you're just ahead.
Did you hear the wind? That was me.

lines.zh: 你起步晚了半拍，我看见。
lines.en: You started half a beat late — I saw it.

lines.zh: 跑起来的时候，我只有一张嘴。
lines.en: When I run, only one mouth shows.

lines.zh: 你的汗味在拐角停住了。
lines.en: Your sweat-smell stops at the corner.
When I sprint, don't look back.

lines.zh: 一个人也够我跑一趟了。
lines.en: One is enough to make the trip worth it.
Run — I've waited long enough.
One burst of speed is enough.
My legs are already bent toward you.
Chased all this way — it was you.

lines.zh: 你的脚印还在泥里冒气。
lines.en: Your footprints are still steaming in the mud.

lines.zh: 冲刺形态，脚步比声音先到。
lines.en: Sprinting form — my steps arrive before the sound.

lines.zh: 你喘成这样，我还没热身。
lines.en: You're gasping, and I'm not even warm yet.
Your shoe's behind you, and you've no time to grab it.

lines.zh: 你喘成这样，我就放心了
lines.en: Hearing you pant like that puts me at ease

lines.zh: 这条走廊比我熟的没几个。
lines.en: Few know this corridor better than I.

lines.zh: 你往左，先撞上我的影子。
lines.en: Go left and you'll hit my shadow first.
I can catch you at a walk.

lines.zh: 你跑快了，我可就认真了。
lines.en: Run that fast and I'll stop playing.
I hear your steps clearly.
You're running the wrong way — closer to me.
That wall ahead — I know it well.

lines.zh: 我追你的时候，风都在叫。
lines.en: When I chase, the wind screams too.
At a sprint, even the wind screams.
I walk fast, so you have to run.

lines.zh: 你带我绕了圈，正好热身。
lines.en: You led me in a circle — good warm-up.
I'm right at your heels — don't stop.
The door shut — I'll come over the window.

lines.zh: 你的喘气声在墙间来回。
lines.en: Your panting bounces between the walls.

lines.zh: 拐弯的时候，我不用减速。
lines.en: At corners, I don't slow down.

lines.zh: 你忘了关灯，我跑得更顺。
lines.en: You left the light on; it smooths my run.
A cabinet won't stop my speed.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸，贴着你的脖子。
lines.en: My breath is right at your neck.
Shut your mouth; the wind will scream for you.
My hand arrives first, my mouths after.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，比挥手还随便。
lines.en: I slam in, as casually as a wave.

lines.zh: 站好别动，我冲刺时收不住。
lines.en: Stand still; I cannot brake at a sprint.

lines.zh: 你的尖叫跟不上我的步子。
lines.en: Your screams can't keep up with my stride.
My arm brushed you — that counts.
If you run, you have already lost.
Bad form. Fast enough.

lines.zh: 我追上你时，嘴已经张开了。
lines.en: By the time I catch you, my mouth is open.

lines.zh: 躯干上的嘴先咬，头再补一口。
lines.en: The torso mouth bites first, then the head.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，可没有脚步声。
lines.en: When I run, I make no footsteps.

lines.zh: 别躲，我这点速度不算快。
lines.en: Don't dodge; this speed is nothing for me.

lines.zh: 跑起来的风，先推你一把。
lines.en: The wind of my run shoves you first.
Lowering your hands won't be fast enough.
The sprinting legs are already trembling.
I can't stand still; my legs are twitching.

lines.zh: 我冲过来，不带一点声音。
lines.en: I charge without a sound.
Hello — I came at a run.
My shadow got left at the bottom of the slope.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，你听得见脚步。
lines.en: When I run, you hear the footsteps.
I ran here, and my name fell behind.

lines.zh: 这次我用走的，你追不上。
lines.en: This time I'll walk, and you still can't keep up.
You run, and I speed up.
My shadow has not caught up yet.
I'm faster than the footsteps.
Still daylight; I'll do a lap first.

lines.zh: 就你一个，我跑得很尽兴。
lines.en: Only you — I'll enjoy the run.
The smell of iron grows nearer — blood.
This world is long enough to run.
In the blink of an eye, I'm there.

lines.zh: 我从坡上冲下来，别回头。
lines.en: I charge down the slope — don't look back.
Walls don't stop my charge.

lines.zh: 我冲过来的时候，别眨眼。
lines.en: Don't blink when I sprint.
This shadow — I am back again.

lines.zh: 冲刺的姿势，腿都快甩开了。
lines.en: At a sprint, my legs nearly come loose.

lines.zh: 火追不上我，可它烧着了。
lines.en: The fire can't catch me, but it lit me up.
I should not have looked down.

lines.zh: 水里跑不动，我沉得很慢。
lines.en: I can't run in water, so I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我撕成两截，我还是往前。
lines.en: The blast tore me in two, and I still come on.

lines.zh: 你躲在远处射我，我记下了。
lines.en: You shot me from afar. Noted.
The magic drags at my legs.
Running this long, my bones rattle.
That thunder was too close.

lines.zh: 这里没有风，我跑不起来。
lines.en: There's no wind here; I can't build speed.
